title: Configure the request address for the search form
goal: Set the action, method and submittable field names of the search form.
summary: The server agrees to receive the keyword parameter q through GET /catalog. The preview will remain in the current exercise and question reading form configuration.
tasks: Set the action of #catalog-search to /catalog and explicitly write method="get".
Set type="search" and name="q" for #query, keeping the label and submit button.

example.code:
<form action="/find" method="get">
  <input type="search" name="term" aria-label="search keyword">
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
</form>
example.note: When you enter css and submit, the query becomes /find?term=css. Variable names come from the name attribute.

hint: id is used to associate labels and positioning elements, and name determines the field name submitted to the server.
